{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hey! I've got something I'd like you

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Oye! Aquí tengo algo a lo que te

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Can I run something by you?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} This is

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Puedo enseñarte algo?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Esto no

{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Man, just thinking about their face

{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Vaya, es que me imagino su cara

FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Hé hé, j'imagine sa tête au moment

{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Penso alla faccia dell'autore di

e...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} mi fa troppo ridere!

piacere ricevere una lettera!
Persino a me, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Gibt's was Besseres als 'nen
Brief zu bekommen? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}If you send me a letter, I'll be sure
to read it!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Si me mandas una carta, ¡te
prometo que la voy a leer

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}En tout cas, si d'aventure tu venais

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Se mai dovessi spedirmi una lettera,

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}So,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} und jetzt übste das, was du

Brief schreibst!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}This letter,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} it's got me all fired up

{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡Esta carta{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} me ha dado unas ganas

{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Et voilà. Maintenant, c'est moi qu'ai

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Haha!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Getting letters like this makes

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ji, ji!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Esto de recibir cartas

unas cosillas a los colegas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hi hi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est l'genre de missive qui
t'donne envie d'revoir tes vieilles
copines !
